name: ont-059-fixture-shop
description: e2e fixture for recorded exclusions: a Prisma SQLite source with Customer -> Order plus an ApiCredential table that must never reach the agent. Three models is the minimum that lets the scenario refuse one, keep two, and still add a fourth mid-run to prove a model appearing AFTER the refusal is still reported. Copied into a scratch run dir under .docs/scratch by the e2e; bare imports in generated code resolve via the monorepo-root node_modules walk-up. No database is needed — every claim is read off generated bytes, the recorded baseline, and CLI exit codes.
